_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. pine-lang bumped to its tagged 0.48.1 and beamlynx-ui to its tagged 0.65.0, a pair that has to move together: beamlynx-ui 0.65.0 needs pine-lang 0.48 for $variables and values blocks, and brings recipes (Ctrl+S, Ctrl+O) that this app stores. 0.48.1, not 0.48.0: 0.48.0's jar doesn't build.
